title: Answer
text:
The moment Mira keyed the response sequence, every light in the structure came on at once — not electric light, but something colder, bluer, moving like it was thinking.

ORSA: Structure is responding. I am reading... a second signal. Human origin. Encrypted with a cipher this ship's registry predates.

Tobias Lin: Older than the Halcyon? That thing's fifteen years old.

Mira Okafor: Not older than the ship. Older than the cipher standard the ship uses. ORSA, when was that standard retired?

ORSA: Sixty-one years ago.

Tobias went quiet in a way that Mira had never once heard from him.

Tobias Lin: Someone's been down here answering this thing for sixty-one years.

Mira Okafor: Or something has.

storyboard.action: The chamber lights up as Mira transmits the response sequence
storyboard.emotion: Tense, wonder giving way to dread
